test_inputs.product_description: This is a test simple product created by an automated agent in the Magento admin.

test_inputs.explanation: The execution trace only exposes navigation URLs (including the create simple product URL with set/4/type/simple), but not the exact field values used. To provide working replay inputs, standard, valid Magento admin credentials and typical product values were inferred consistent with the tool description: username/password from the examples; attribute_set="Default" and product_type="Simple Product" from the new product URL; and reasonable, unique product data (name, descriptions, SKU, price, qty, etc.) that satisfy all required fields. These values are realistic and sufficient to successfully exercise the tool end‑to‑end, but they are inferred defaults rather than directly observed literals from the trace.
